## Coaching Note

**Your key move: Be5+**

You had a classic tactic staring you in the face—a **fork**. Your bishop can check the king while simultaneously attacking the rook on d6. Since the rook is undefended, White must move the king to safety, and you capture the rook on the next move. When your opponent leaves a piece undefended, always scan for checks that attack it simultaneously. This pattern wins material every time.
